info.title: Convo API
info.description:
The Convo API gives your code the sales calls Convo records: transcripts, key points, coaching feedback, follow-up emails, contact briefings and webhooks. Build integrations with Zapier, Make or your own applications.

## Authentication
Send `Authorization: Bearer convo_...` with a key created in the Convo desktop app under **Settings → Convo API**. Keys work on Starter, Professional and Enterprise plans.

## Plans
| | Starter | Professional | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|
| API keys | 1 | 3 | 10 |
| Requests per hour | 100 | 500 | 2,000 |
| AI credits per month | 1,500 | 15,000 | 30,000 |
| Webhooks | No | 3 | 999 |
| Contacts (Convo Memory) | No | With Memory | With Memory |

The desktop app's AI features use the same credits. See https://docs.itsconvo.com/tiers.

## Rate limits
Successful responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Over the hourly limit you get `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`.

get.description: Returns your recorded calls, newest first. `search` matches the title or any words in the transcript, case-insensitive. `since` keeps only transcript from that time on, so for a call that started earlier, `startTime`, `duration` and `segmentCount` cover only the later part. `pagination.total` counts every matching call.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Calls per page, 1 to 100. Larger values are lowered to 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches the title or transcript text, case-insensitive

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only transcript from this time on (ISO 8601)

get.description: Returns the transcript recorded during the call, oldest segment first. Returns 404 for a call that doesn't exist or was deleted.

post.description: Returns the saved key points, or generates them when there are none. `forceRefresh: true` generates them again. Key points don't use AI credits. Generating fires `conversation.keypoints.ready`, plus `conversation.summary.ready` when there are sections and `conversation.action_items.ready` when there are action items.

post.description: Returns the saved feedback, or generates it when there is none. `forceRefresh: true` generates it again. Generating uses one AI credit. post.description: Answers a question about one call from its transcript. Each request uses one AI credit. A call that doesn't exist returns 404 without using one. `suggestedQueries` are fixed follow-up questions picked from words in your question.

query.example: What were the main action items?

data.query: What were the main action items?
data.response: Two action items were identified: (1) Alice will draft an enterprise hiring plan by next week, and (2) Bob will prepare an SMB retention proposal by end of April.
suggestedQueries: Who is responsible for each task?
Draft an email summarizing this meeting

post.description: Drafts a follow-up email from the call. Each request uses one AI credit. A call that doesn't exist returns 404 without using one. The body is optional.

data.subject: Follow-up: Q1 Planning Review
data.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for joining the Q1 Planning Review today. Here are the key takeaways:

- Revenue increased 15% quarter-over-quarter, with enterprise leading at 22% growth
- Customer retention held at 94%, though SMB churn needs attention

Action items:
- Alice: Draft enterprise hiring plan by next week
- Bob: Prepare SMB retention proposal by end of April

Let me know if I missed anything.

Best,
Alice
actionItems: Draft enterprise hiring plan (Alice, next week)
Prepare SMB retention proposal (Bob, end of April)

post.description: Makes the call readable by anyone with the link and returns the link. Fires `conversation.shared`.

patch.description: Renames the call. Spaces around the title are removed. The title is stored with the key points, so a call without key points returns 404. Fires `conversation.updated`.

delete.description: Deletes the call. It no longer appears in the API or the app, and it is unlinked from your Convo Memory contacts. The API can't restore it. Fires `conversation.deleted`.

get.description: Returns upcoming events from the calendar connected in the Convo desktop app, Google or Outlook, by start time. Events come in the provider's own format. Declined and cancelled events are left out. Without `timeMax`, Outlook looks 7 days ahead and Google has no end.

parameters.name: timeMin
parameters.description: Start of the window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

403.description: Calendar access was revoked. Reconnect the calendar in the desktop app.

error.message: Calendar permissions revoked. Please reconnect your calendar.
Calendar not connected. Connect your calendar in the Convo dashboard.

get.description: Returns your profile, your plan and how many AI credits you have used this month.
Lists your active webhooks, newest first. Secrets are not returned. Professional and Enterprise.

403.description: Webhooks need a Professional or Enterprise plan, or the webhook limit is reached

error.message: Webhooks require a Professional plan or above.

post.description: Registers a URL for the events you choose. The URL must use HTTPS and can't point to localhost or a private network. Professional plans can have 3 webhooks and Enterprise 999. The `secret` appears only in this response.

403.description: Webhooks need a Professional or Enterprise plan, or the webhook limit is reached

error.message: Webhooks require a Professional plan or above.

delete.description: Deletes a webhook. Send its `id` in the JSON body. Works on any paid plan, so you can remove webhooks after a downgrade.

post.description: Sends a signed `webhook.test` event to one of your webhooks and returns your server's status code. `delivered` is true whenever your server answered, whatever the status, so check `statusCode`. If your server doesn't answer within 10 seconds, the response is 200 with `delivered: false`.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to test

403.description: Webhooks need a Professional or Enterprise plan, or the webhook limit is reached

error.message: Webhooks require a Professional plan or above.

get.description: The people Convo Memory has met in your calendar meetings, most meetings first, then most recently seen. Requires a Professional or Enterprise plan with Convo Memory enabled. Without Memory, the list is empty and `reason` is `no-brain`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches email or display name, case-insensitive

reason.description: Present when Convo Memory is not enabled on the account

get.description: Open action items from meetings with your contacts, oldest meeting first, so the ones waiting longest come first. Items you marked resolved or dismissed are left out, and so are meetings not matched to a contact. Requires a Professional or Enterprise plan with Convo Memory enabled. Without Memory, the list is empty and `reason` is `no-brain`.

reason.description: Present when Convo Memory is not enabled on the account

data.actionItem: Send the pilot pricing to Sarah

get.description: Everything Convo Memory has on one contact before your next call: the relationship summary, recent meetings, open action items and recent decisions. Requires a Professional or Enterprise plan with Convo Memory enabled. Without Memory, it returns 403. A contact from another account returns 404.

parameters.name: historyLimit
parameters.description: How many recent meetings to read for the briefing

summary.prose: Sarah leads operations at Northwind and is evaluating a three-month pilot.
open_questions: Who signs off on the pilot budget?

openActionItems.item: Send the pilot pricing to Sarah

recentDecisions: Start the pilot with the support team

bearerAuth.description: A Convo API key: `convo_` followed by 32 hex characters. Create it in the Convo desktop app under Settings → Convo API.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per hour on your plan

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds of the next full hour (UTC), when the count resets

title.description: Null when the call has no key points yet

duration.description: Minutes between the first and last segment

speaker.description: `local` is you, from your microphone. Other people are usually `remote`.

topPriority.description: Optional. The single highest-leverage focus area to act on before the next call — synthesized from across the growth areas, not necessarily a copy of growthAreas[0]. Absent when the call was too brief/routine for a clear priority, or in feedback generated before this field existed.

focus.description: Short imperative theme, 4-8 words ('Slow down before committing to scope').

quote.description: Verbatim anchoring moment from the user's transcript.

reason.description: Why this is the #1 priority for next call (1-2 sentences).

alternative.description: Verbatim line the user could have said instead. Rendered as a 'Try saying' callout.

quote.description: Verbatim line the user said (primary content for chat-bubble rendering).

reason.description: Why this specific moment landed well (1-2 sentences).

quote.description: Verbatim line the user said that could be improved.

reason.description: Why this moment fell short (1-2 sentences).

alternative.description: Verbatim better phrasing the user could have used instead. Rendered as a 'Try saying' callout.

talkListenRatio.description: Talk-to-listen ratio as a percentage (0 to 100), estimated by the model

stats.description: Added when the feedback is generated through the API

talkListenRatio.description: Same as `talkListenRatio`, 50 when the model gave none

totalMinutes.description: Minutes between the first and last segment

userSpeakerName.description: The speaker Convo scored as you: `local` (your microphone), a speaker whose name matches yours, or `Unknown`

CalendarEvent.description: An event in the calendar provider's own format, passed through unchanged. Google Calendar events look like this. Outlook events are Microsoft Graph events, with `subject`, `start`, `end` and `attendees[].emailAddress` instead.

used.description: AI credits used this month (UTC), including by the desktop app

limit.description: AI credits per month on your plan

remaining.description: `limit` minus `used`. A daily cap of a third of `limit`, or the monthly spending cap, can stop generation earlier.

resetsAt.description: The first day of next month, 00:00 UTC

secret.description: Signing secret: `whsec_` followed by 48 hex characters. Shown only in this response.

url.description: An HTTPS URL. Localhost and private network addresses are refused.

companyDomain.description: The email domain; null for personal email providers

sessionId.description: The conversation the action item came from

actionItem.example: Send the pilot pricing to Sarah

hash.description: Identifies the action item within its conversation

item.example: Send the pilot pricing to Sarah

hash.description: Identifies the action item within its conversation

summary.description: What Convo Memory knows about this relationship, or null before a summary exists

recentMeetings.description: The most recent meetings with this contact, newest first

openActionItems.description: Up to 10 open action items from those meetings, newest meeting first

recentDecisions.description: Up to 10 decisions from those meetings, without repeats

Unauthorized.description: The Authorization header is missing, or the key is wrong or revoked

error.message: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Use: Bearer <api_key>

Forbidden.description: The plan doesn't allow this request, or the key only works with the MCP server

error.message: API access requires a Starter plan or above. Upgrade at https://www.itsconvo.com/pricing

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next full hour, when the count resets

error.message: Rate limit exceeded (100 requests per hour for starter plan)

AILimitExceeded.description: Your monthly, daily or spending limit for AI credits is reached. The model provider being busy returns `429 rate_limited` instead, without headers.

error.message: Monthly AI generation limit reached. Upgrade your plan for more.

ValidationError.description: A field or parameter is missing or wrong. The message names it.

error.message: title is required and must be a non-empty string
